findings.title: Feature flag renders dashboard tables with empty data
findings.body: When `use-table-widget-visualization` is enabled, `tableResultComponent` ignores the fetched `result` and renders `TableWidgetVisualization` with `columns={[]}` and `tableData` hard-coded to empty `data`/`meta`. Every table widget behind that flag shows a blank table instead of the query results, field aliases, and custom renderers that the old chart still uses.

findings.title: PR comment helpers are on the wrong class and call a missing method
findings.body: `get_environment_info` and `get_merged_pr_single_issue_template` were added to `CommitContextIntegration`, but GitHub/GitLab call them as `self.get_merged_pr_single_issue_template` / `self.get_environment_info` on `PRCommentWorkflow` subclasses, which do not inherit those methods. The static helper also calls `PRCommentWorkflow._truncate_title`, while `_truncate_title` is defined on `CommitContextIntegration`. Posting a merged-PR suspect-issue comment will raise AttributeError before a comment is sent.

findings.title: Error events are paired by dict value order, not node id
findings.body: `fetch_error_details` builds `node_ids` from `error_ids`, then zips `error_ids` with `nodestore.backend.get_multi(...).values()`. Dict iteration order is not guaranteed to match the input id list, so an error can be labeled with another event's id, title, and message in the Seer log. Look up each payload by its generated node id instead of zipping `.values()`.

findings.title: Error timestamps from nodestore are compared as if they were floats
findings.body: Event node `timestamp` is typically an ISO-8601 string, but `ErrorEvent` types it as `float` and `gen_request_data` compares it with `<` against breadcrumb timestamps (numbers). A string/float comparison raises TypeError outside the try/except in `fetch_error_details`, so any replay that has linked errors fails the summarize endpoint with 500 instead of producing a summary.

findings.title: Hidden span attributes are only filtered while searching
findings.body: `HIDDEN_ATTRIBUTES` (`is_segment`, `project_id`, `received`) is applied only inside the search branch. When `searchQuery` is empty the function returns the full sorted list, so those fields stay visible in the default attributes tree—the opposite of hiding them—and disappear only after the user types a query.

findings.title: Saved-search conversion migrations are no-ops with no replacement in this PR
findings.body: Both 0917 and 0920 now return immediately and their tests were deleted. The comments point at `0921_convert_org_saved_searches_to_views_rerevised.py`, which is not part of this change. Environments that have not already applied the old data migration will never copy organization saved searches into `GroupSearchView`.

findings.title: 60s deadline is too short for a 100-identity refresh batch
findings.body: `check_auth_identities` walks up to `chunk_size` (100) identities and calls `provider.refresh_identity` (external IdP HTTP) for each, but `processing_deadline_duration` is 60 seconds. A slow batch is killed mid-loop; `last_synced` was already advanced in `check_auth`, so those identities are skipped until the next interval, and a retry can overlap with identities already refreshed in the same chunk.
